title: MultiTable: A Faster Hash Table at any Physical Load Factor up to and Including One
summary: We present \emph{multitable} and its Rust reference implementation: a stable hash table both materially faster at equal physical memory and more flexible than the SwissTable in its Rust's hashbrown implementation. As an arithmetic mean over 84 configurations it delivers $\mathbf{2.1\times}$ hashbrown's throughput when both hash the same raw bytes and $\mathbf{1.9\times}$ when hashbrown is keyed on native integers, its best case; on negative lookups alone, $3.2\times$ and $2.9\times$.
